overview.description: The micropipette is the most important tool in your arsenal. Accurate, confident pipetting underpins every protocol in this tree - get comfortable here and everything downstream gets easier.
prerequisites: a set of micropipettes and tips

instructions.title: Pick the right pipette
instructions.description: Choose the pipette whose range brackets your target volume; never set beyond the marked range.

instructions.title: Set the volume
instructions.description: Dial to the target volume, reading the digits correctly for each pipette model.

instructions.title: Aspirate & dispense
instructions.description: Press to the first stop to draw up; use the second stop to fully expel. Pipette slowly to avoid bubbles.

instructions.title: Verify accuracy
instructions.description: Practise with coloured water and, if possible, check by weighing on a balance.

submission.description: Demonstrate accurate transfers across P10/P100/P1000 (a photo or short clip), and note any accuracy check you performed.
